elaine: quick Q — validating the zephyr-gen canary in eu-west. where do i find the logs + dashboards? i need 5xx/p95 + kv-cache misses and want a saved search for org=acme, model=zephyr-gen, route=/generate, region=eu-west, status!=200

nate: use the logsearch saved views. quick query snip below, i can pin a saved search into ops/shared if that helps.

nate: ```
org:\"acme\" AND model:\"zephyr-gen\" AND route:\"/generate\" AND region:\"eu-west\" AND (status:[500 TO 599] OR status:429 OR kv_cache_miss:true)
| sort @timestamp desc
```

maria: also add `request_type:streaming` if you want to exclude streaming noise, or `!request_type:streaming` to keep non-streaming only.

ops-oncall: dashboards: latency p95 + tail, plus kv-miss rate panel. grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/zephyr/canary-overview?org=acme (filters pre-set to eu-west & zephyr-gen)

sam: i created a saved search: https://logs.redwood.com/saved/acme/zephyr-eu-canary-5xx — go to Logs > Saved searches and click \"Save view\" > choose folder Ops/Canaries to share.

observability-bot: SavedSearchCreated: zephyr-eu-canary-5xx by sam at 2026-03-15T12:03:21Z

elaine: perfect. one more thing — can we tune the 5xx alert? current threshold is noisy during deploys. proposing: trigger when 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 3m (was 0.1% for 5m). also suppress for recent deploy tags.

ops-oncall: sounds right for canaries. i'll open a PR to modify the alert to: `if (five_xx_rate > 0.5%) for 3m AND not(deploy_tagged_recently)`; also add 10m backoff for flakey infra.

nate: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/876 — pinging @maria @sam for quick review.

maria: :thumbsup: will review now.

elaine: thanks all — i'll run through the saved search and dashboards, will report any odd traces. pls pin the saved search to #eng-sre when you have a sec.
